Headline:
Make it.
Every day.

Future: Makeet is free: unlimited habits, statistics, planning and private sync across devices. No subscriptions or in-app purchases. Stay on your device or sign in with Apple or Google.

Features.Title: More than a checkmark
Features.Body: Count glasses, pages, minutes or repetitions, several times a day and beyond your goal. Minus on the left, plus on the right: adjust a quantity and keep going.

Features.Title: Goals to reach or limits to respect
Features.Body: Choose a goal to reach or a limit not to exceed, including zero. Occurrences above the limit count as a penalty. Confirm zero to distinguish a day with no occurrences from an unlogged day. If you enable it, minus can take your balance below zero; history and statistics preserve the sign.

Features.Title: A week of your own
Features.Body: Monday, Tuesday and Thursday? Pick days for each habit, along with a goal, increment, icon or emoji. Rest days do not break your streak.

Features.Title: A history you can correct
Features.Body: Edit past-day quantities from the calendar, review and save. You can also change a habit, archive it, restore it or permanently delete it and its progress after confirmation.

Features.Title: A plan that looks ahead
Features.Body: Plan today, 7, 14 or 28 days. Makeet suggests slots using your chosen days, preferred times, progress and commitments. Review and confirm before future events are created.

Features.Title: Calendars, with your permission
Features.Body: Choose which device calendars to read and where to add Makeet blocks. Google Calendar works when configured on your device; events sync according to the calendar provider’s settings.

Features.Title: See what works for you
Features.Body: Explore quantities, consistency, streaks and logging times. The monthly view gives you the full picture; statistics help you notice your patterns.

Questions.Title: When can I download it?
Questions.Body: Makeet is in internal iPhone testing through TestFlight. A public App Store link will appear here when the app is available. The Mac version and widgets are in development and validation.

Questions.Title: Do I need an account?
Questions.Body: No. Guided onboarding lets you choose: keep progress only on your device, or sign in with Apple or Google. Your local archive is not uploaded automatically; importing it requires your choice.

Questions.Title: Is it free?
Questions.Body: Makeet is free: unlimited habits, statistics, planning and private sync across devices. No subscriptions or in-app purchases. Stay on your device or sign in with Apple or Google.

Questions.Title: Does it work with Apple and Google Calendar?
Questions.Body: Makeet uses calendars you configure and select on your device, including Apple and Google. Signing in with Google identifies your Makeet account; it does not connect Google Calendar by itself. Event details stay on your device. A direct Google Calendar connection is not yet available.

Questions.Title: Does it create events by itself?
Questions.Body: Every plan needs your review and confirmation, including plans up to 28 days ahead. Makeet checks conflicts and duplicates again before saving. A calendar event never marks a habit as completed.

Questions.Title: Which languages are supported?
Questions.Body: Italian, English, French, German and Spanish, with a language choice from the first onboarding screen. Habit names and units you write stay exactly as you enter them.

Policy.PrivacyIntro: This notice explains how Makeet handles information in the app, account service, website and support. During development, account features become available only after service checks. You can use the local archive without an account.
Policy.HostingTitle: Country of the primary account server

PrivacySections.Title: Information and purposes
PrivacySections.Body: Without sign-in, habits, quantities, activity times, statistics and planning stay in the app archive on your device. With an account, we store your provider identifier, email supplied by Apple or Google, and habits and activity entries you synchronize, including names, icons, targets, units, times and time zones. We use these to provide your private archive and sync across your devices. We do not receive your Apple or Google password. You can add a private display name and profile photo, synced with your account. On the first Google sign-in we may use the name and image supplied by Google; Apple does not supply a photo. You can change or remove it. The system picker reads only your selected image, which we resize and strip of metadata before storage. The profile is not public and is deleted with the account. The habit names and quantities you choose may describe wellness or exercise routines. These are user-entered details; Makeet does not read HealthKit or motion-sensor records.

PrivacySections.Title: Calendars and planning
PrivacySections.Body: Calendar access is optional. The app reads only the device calendars you select to calculate availability, and writes an event only after your confirmation. Calendar events, attendees and calendar credentials are not uploaded to the Makeet backend. The calendar provider configured on your device may synchronize events under its own settings. The planner runs on the device using habit settings and past logging times; no external AI service receives this information. A direct Google Calendar connection is not currently provided.

PrivacySections.Title: Notifications
PrivacySections.Body: Notifications require device permission. When signed in, the service stores an installation identifier, an encrypted Apple push token, language, time zone and your optional reminder time. It uses synchronized progress to decide whether a daily reminder is needed. Alerts contain generic text, not habit names or quantities. The service records sending attempts, Apple acceptance and a receipt when the app sees or you open a notification. You can disable reminders in the app or notifications in device settings.

PrivacySections.Title: Legal grounds and choices
PrivacySections.Body: Providing accounts, synchronization and requested support is necessary to perform the service you request (GDPR Article 6(1)(b)). Optional calendar access and notifications are used following your choice and device permission; where consent is the legal basis, you may withdraw it at any time (Article 6(1)(a)). Security, abuse prevention and essential technical operation rely on legitimate interests (Article 6(1)(f)); you may object. Without identity information, we cannot create an account, but the local archive remains available. Optional permissions are not required for local habit tracking.

PrivacySections.Title: Service providers and international processing
PrivacySections.Body: Cloudflare provides HTTPS protection and email routing; DigitalOcean hosts the traffic relay. Apple provides sign-in and push delivery. Google provides sign-in and processes support email. These services receive information needed for their respective roles, and may process it outside the European Economic Area, including the United States. Cloudflare describes the Data Privacy Framework and Standard Contractual Clauses in its DPA; Apple and Google describe their transfer safeguards in the policies linked below. Contact support@makeet.app for information about applicable safeguards. We do not sell personal data, use advertising trackers, or share habits for advertising. If you choose Google sign-in, its SDK also declares collection of phone information, approximate location, identifiers, other usage data and other technical data. Google uses identifiers, usage data and other technical data for its own analytics as described in its privacy policy. Makeet receives only the identity and profile information needed for your account; it does not request phone or location permissions. The Google SDK does not receive your habit archive from Makeet.

PrivacySections.Title: Retention and deletion
PrivacySections.Body: Synchronized data and revision history are retained until account deletion. Successful account deletion removes account data and active sessions from the service; Apple authorization is revoked before deletion is confirmed. If provider revocation fails, deletion is not reported as complete and can be retried. Session authorization expires within 30 days; access tokens within 15 minutes. Push delivery records are retained for up to 30 days. Restricted backups rotate within 30 days. Support messages are retained for resolving the request and any necessary legal obligations; security records only while needed for protection and investigation. Removing a server account does not erase a separate local archive, existing calendar events or another device’s offline copy.

PrivacySections.Title: Security and local storage
PrivacySections.Body: Connections use HTTPS. Account stores are separated by user; service tokens use device-only Keychain storage and push/provider tokens are encrypted on the server. Synchronized habit data is processed by the backend and is not end-to-end encrypted. The app and widgets use local storage for their functions. The website has no advertising or analytics scripts; infrastructure may use essential security mechanisms.

PrivacySections.Title: Your rights and contact
PrivacySections.Body: Write to support@makeet.app to request access, correction, deletion, restriction, portability, or to object to processing where applicable. We may need proportionate identity verification. You may withdraw consent without affecting earlier lawful processing and lodge a complaint with your data protection authority, including the Italian Garante. In-app account deletion is available under Connections > Account. Planning suggestions do not make legal or similarly significant automated decisions about you.

PrivacySections.Title: Changes
PrivacySections.Body: We update this notice when processing changes and show the updated date. Material changes will also be communicated in the app. If you believe a child has supplied information without appropriate authorization, contact support for review and removal.

Policy.TermsIntro: Meaningtech provides Makeet for personal habit tracking. These terms apply to use of the app and account service. The current version is in development; the website does not yet offer an App Store download.

TermsSections.Title: Your archive and account
TermsSections.Body: You may use a local archive without signing in. Apple or Google sign-in is required for private account synchronization. Keep access to your identity provider secure. Signing in with different providers may create separate accounts; accounts are not automatically merged by email.

TermsSections.Title: Free access
TermsSections.Body: Makeet is free: unlimited habits, statistics, planning and private sync across devices. No subscriptions or in-app purchases. Stay on your device or sign in with Apple or Google.

TermsSections.Title: Logging and planning
TermsSections.Body: You control habit targets, quantities, corrections and reminders. Calendar blocks do not mark a habit complete. Review scheduling proposals and confirm calendar writes. Availability may change between planning and confirmation; review events in your calendar.

TermsSections.Title: Synchronization and availability
TermsSections.Body: Sync requires a connection and a valid session. Offline changes wait for the app to reconnect. If changes conflict, the app asks which version to keep. Notifications and widget updates depend on the operating system and are not guaranteed at an exact time. Features may change during development; significant changes are communicated in the app or on this site.

TermsSections.Title: Acceptable use
TermsSections.Body: Use the service lawfully, respect other people’s privacy and do not try to access another account, bypass security or disrupt the service. We may restrict access needed to investigate abuse or protect users. Your habit content remains yours.

TermsSections.Title: Leaving Makeet
TermsSections.Body: Sign out or delete your account from Connections > Account. Export any data you want to keep first. Successful deletion removes your account and its data from the service. Existing calendar events and independent local archives are not automatically removed. See the privacy notice for retention and contact support@makeet.app for help.

TermsSections.Title: Contact and applicable rights
TermsSections.Body: Contact Meaningtech at support@makeet.app. Apple’s Standard End User License Agreement also applies to the App Store application; the link below provides its full text. These terms do not limit mandatory consumer or data protection rights.

Policy.DeletionIntro: Delete your Makeet account from the app, or contact support if you cannot access it. Signing out alone does not delete the account.

DeletionSections.Title: In the app
DeletionSections.Body: Open Connections, find Account, choose Delete account and confirm. A connection is required. The app confirms only after the service has deleted the account; if Apple authorization cannot be revoked, retry when the service is available.

DeletionSections.Title: What is removed
DeletionSections.Body: Successful deletion removes your provider-linked account, synchronized habits and activity records, sessions and push registrations from the service. The active device clears its account archive. Restricted backup copies rotate within 30 days. Other offline devices may retain their cached copies until opened or erased.

DeletionSections.Title: What stays separate
DeletionSections.Body: A local archive used without an account and calendar events already created are separate. Delete local habits or remove events in your calendar if you also want to erase them. Deleting Makeet does not delete your Apple or Google account.

DeletionSections.Title: If you cannot sign in
DeletionSections.Body: Write to support@makeet.app requesting Makeet account deletion and identify the sign-in provider. Do not send passwords or tokens. Support may request a proportionate verification of ownership. Privacy rights and retention details are described in the privacy notice.
